title: roi-mammo: code for "Region-of-Interest Augmentation for Mammography Classification under Patient-Level Cross-Validation"
description: Code, pre-registered analysis plan (with addenda A and B), the placement-matched control and the post-review reanalysis for a controlled evaluation of label-free, saliency-guided region-of-interest (ROI) cropping as a training augmentation for breast-level mammogram classification on Mini-DDSM and CMMD, compared with standard augmentation, RandomResizedCrop, CutMix, size-matched random crops and placement-matched random boxes. Accompanies arXiv:2509.20585 (v3).
